comparison.objective: Lift a garment care label, pierce only the label with a tagging gun, and fire one fastener.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a thin flap clear while precisely inserting a needle and actuating a trigger; no threaded coupling or torque preservation.
comparison.success_condition: Fastener through the label alone, shirt unpierced, needle withdrawn, and label released; both available spec versions provide numeric thresholds.
comparison.reason: This tests selective piercing of a supported thin layer, not adjustment locking and retained mechanical motion.
